question: What is the current release of Autodesk Inventor?
answer:
Based on Autodesk Inventor 2027.2, released on November 10, 2026 [2]. That is the current release: the Autodesk forum announcement says it was released that day and is available from Autodesk Account or Access [2]. Autodesk's own blog, dated November 3, 2026, also covers 2027.2 as the latest release [1]. It follows the initial Inventor 2027 release from this spring [1].

The sources don't give a build number for 2027.2.

keyPoints.text: Inventor 2027.2 was released on 2026-11-10 and is the current Inventor Professional release.
The Inventor 2027.2 blog post (dated 2026-11-03) describes it as the latest release to install.
Inventor 2027.2 adds Autodesk Assistant enhancements, assembly constraint updates, and model state improvements.
Autodesk's Inventor product page lists Inventor 2027 and says subscribers can install the current version plus the three previous versions.

mayBeStale.text: The Inventor product overview page (undated) names Inventor 2027 rather than 2027.2, so it likely predates the 2027.2 release.
The 2026 download links thread (dated 2026-11-05) concerns the previous 2026 release, not the current one.
